headline: PCB: PVcomBank successfully raises 200 billion dong through bonds at a record interest rate of 10.5% per year
summary: PVcomBank has completed a VND 200 billion bond issue with a 10-year term and a first-year interest rate of up to 10.5%. The article describes this as the highest rate in the current bank bond market.
why: PVcomBank is a Vietnamese commercial bank, and its bond pricing signals funding costs in the local bank debt market. Rising bank bond yields matter for credit and lending conditions.
